name: @cfs/erp-spec-spike-harness
//: Exact pins, no caret ranges. deno.lock is gitignored repo-wide, so this file IS the lockfile.

imports.//core-pins: SPIKE-006 imports the real @cfs/core schemas. These three MUST track core/deno.json — a version skew resolves a second Zod instance and every instanceof check silently fails.
imports.//solid: SPIKE-009 criterion 1. Version tracks manager/package.json (^1.9.12) — the slice measures the CURRENT client library. ⚠️ `?target=es2022` IS LOAD-BEARING AND MUST NOT BE DROPPED. Solid ships a reactive browser build and a non-reactive SSR build, and there are TWO independent ways to silently get the SSR one under Deno: `npm:solid-js` honours an explicit `deno` export condition pointing at dist/server.js, and esm.sh serves Deno the same SSR build unless a browser target is forced. In the SSR build createEffect NEVER RUNS and createRenderEffect runs once — so a reactivity test written the obvious way measures NOTHING and reports success. Same class as the Zod double-instance note above: one library, two copies, and every check silently agrees.

//nodeModulesDir: Node-API addons need a real node_modules tree on disk; Deno's default global npm cache does not give the dlopen'ing addon a sibling directory to resolve against.

tasks.//tb-budget: The spec's transfer field budget against tigerbeetle-node's OWN bindings.d.ts. NOT in CI — the ground truth is an unvendored npm package, so no repo-only gate can reach it.
tasks.//tb-import: SPIKE-003 — the `imported` flag's timestamp and monotonicity semantics (ADR-0039). Formats, starts and deletes its OWN clusters, so it needs --allow-run and does NOT use `deno task tb`'s cluster: `imported` is defined against the cluster's last committed timestamp, so a shared cluster measures that cluster's history rather than the flag. Two clusters — one --development, one on production defaults, because --development caps createTransfers at 253 against 8189. Writes only to .data/, which is gitignored.
tasks.//mongo-schema: SPIKE-006 — JSON Schema 2020-12 into MongoDB's $jsonSchema (ADR-0040). Needs a mongod on 127.0.0.1:27077; there is no container runtime on the dev machines, so fetch the official macOS tarball and run mongod directly (--fork works on 8.0.x and is refused by 8.3.x on macOS). Imports the REAL @cfs/core schemas, so the zod/date-fns pins below must track core/deno.json or a second Zod instance resolves.
tasks.//adc: Read-only prod Firestore under ADC (erp-spec#15). `--allow-net` is narrowed to Google's auth and Firestore hosts so the probes CANNOT reach api.xero.com or api.current-rms.com — both single-tenant and live. No --allow-write.
tasks.//inventory: Live Firestore collection+path inventory for m6 / erp-spec#8. Writes migration/live-paths.measured.yaml, which validate.ts checks the field map against.
tasks.//chart: The LIVE chart of accounts for erp-spec#8 step 4. Writes migration/live-chart.measured.yaml, which gate 16 checks ledger/chart-of-accounts.yaml against. Firestore mirror only — never the Xero API.
tasks.//psa: Where a production service agreement's money sits in the live invoice corpus (erp-spec#35). A census of INVOICED lines, never of the GL — an account with no invoice line naming it may still have moved money.
tasks.//boundary: SPIKE-012 — the booking->pending-transfer boundary and order-status derivability (ADR-0015). Read-only prod Firestore under ADC. `--as-of <iso>` pins the reference date; without it the run reads the clock and prints what it read.
tasks.//dep-corpus: SPIKE-005 exit criterion 1 — grades depreciation-corpus.yaml for internal consistency against Pub 946's own stated figures, and asserts COVERAGE of the exit criterion facet by facet. The coverage arm is expected RED until the corpus is finished.
tasks.//dep-candidates: SPIKE-005 exit criterion 2 — sweeps npm and JSR for a US tax depreciation engine and scores the named candidates facet by facet. The finding is an ABSENCE, which is the most perishable kind of claim, so it is re-runnable rather than asserted.
tasks.//dep-refresh: ADR-0043/D7 — fetches the publication the depreciation corpus is pinned against, extracts it LOCALLY with pdftotext, and locates every pinned figure or fails. Red means reconcile against a new edition, not breakage. Needs poppler (pdftotext).
tasks.//two-store: SPIKE-002 criterion 2 — the crash-injection harness for ADR-0042's two-store commit protocol. Needs a local mongod on 27078 and a TigerBeetle cluster on 3044; see _README.md. The writer subprocess SIGKILLs itself, so the state recovery sees is real durable state rather than a simulation.
tasks.//tax-table: SPIKE-008 — the tax decision table the `taxes` registry already encodes, scored against every taxable invoice line TWICE: against CFS's own applied_from, and against the law's effective_from. The gap between them is api-cloudrun#600 with a number.
tasks.//slice-store: SPIKE-009 criterion 1 — the reactivity assertion. A screenshot cannot tell a fine-grained update from a whole-table re-render; an effect count can.
tasks.//slice: SPIKE-009 criterion 1 — the vertical slice: a change stream on one collection, a WebSocket, and a live SolidJS store. Needs the replica set on 27079 (see _README.md); a standalone mongod has no oplog and watch() fails outright. Open http://127.0.0.1:8791, then drive it with `deno task slice-mutate`, which writes to mongod DIRECTLY and never touches this server.
tasks.//change-stream: SPIKE-009 criterion 2 — resume-token semantics against a real replica set: token shape and ordering, resumeAfter exclusivity, the post-batch resume token on a filtered stream, oplog retention, invalidate, and the updateLookup-vs-post-image distinction. Needs the replica set on 27079.
